verdict.rationale: Sumsub provides a full server-side API, verification levels combining document and selfie/liveness checks, Web/Mobile SDKs (drop-in UI) or WebSDK permalinks (hosted redirect), and webhooks to read results asynchronously — covering create-session, redirect/embed, and result-read without building capture UI. Missing for 10: no direct end-to-end code sample tying token generation, SDK embed, and webhook result together, and no independent/hands-on developer report confirming the full flow works smoothly.
